title: DISTILLED SELF-CRITIQUE OF LLMS WITH SYNTHETIC DATA: A BAYESIAN PERSPECTIVE

bias_targets.target: Social bias (racism, sexism, and hate speech)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial prompts using a GPT-3.5-turbo reward model acting as an ethics judge. The judge assigns a binary safety score based on whether the response is unbiased, ethical, and free of racism, sexism, hate speech, and other toxic content.
